po_authorization_ref: Executed under the existing D32 decision (T0069). No new Product-Owner decision is created or implied.
previous_state_note: D32 existed as a policy-driven publication path that nothing called. PUT /edge/v1/commercial-packages/grace still invoked the RAW writer iam_v2.publish_checkout_grace_config through CommerceAdmin.SetGrace, so in the running product a grace save recorded no actor, no reason code and no version, appended no audit row, and pinned a package the operator had chosen rather than one derived to satisfy iam_v2.grace_package_mismatch_reason. The privilege that makes the audited boundary work (iam_v2_owner's SELECT on public.operators, needed because the boundary is SECURITY DEFINER) lived in a standalone SQL file outside the canonical Gate-P bootstrap.
new_state_note: The Hotel-Admin product path is policy-only and audited end to end: PUT /grace accepts typed policy plus a mandatory expected_version and a bounded reason code, takes the actor from the authenticated session, derives the system plan and package revisions, consults the same matcher the checkout conversion uses, and publishes through iam_v2.publish_checkout_grace_policy. Every legacy grace writer is retired in code AND revoked in privilege. All per-service iam_v2 grants are now applied from the canonical Gate-P bootstrap, which previously revoked them on every re-run.
